authority_principle: Issue body is Portable Plan semantic authority. Control comments are operational projections/indexes, not independent semantic authority. Event Log is append-only historical evidence.

objects.AUTHORITY_ROLE: Portable Plan semantic authority (sole authority for plan state; body wins over projections)
objects.WRITE_METHOD: typed Issue body mutation: mutate(PortablePlanMutationRequest with typed_target=plan_ref, operation=plan_init|plan_retirement, candidate_raw_body + candidate_raw_digest + authority_source_revision + authority_observed_raw_digest) -> verifyAfterWrite via readRawAuthority; only via GitHub adapter typed operation, not generic update_issue(number, arbitrary_body)
objects.READBACK_METHOD: readRawAuthority(TargetRef) -> (authority_source_revision, authority_observed_raw_digest, raw_body) via GitHub read Issue adapter (deterministic bounded snapshot: body + revision + digest)
objects.RAW_PRECONDITION_MODEL: authority_source_revision = opaque GitHub raw revision token (e.g., Issue updated_at/etag/ revision-like string or revision integer; observed as read-time token) + authority_observed_raw_digest = SHA-256 of raw body bytes; both must match authorized precondition else STALE_AUTHORITY fail closed; candidate_raw_digest = SHA-256 of exact intended candidate raw bytes; normalized_plan_digest = semantic evidence only, never CAS

objects.AUTHORITY_ROLE: operational projection/index: materialized view of milestone progress derived from Issue body authority
objects.WRITE_METHOD: update canonical control comment in place (update exact comment by ID after role resolution count==1); never append a new canonical role comment every write; duplicate creation is forbidden; creation only via bounded authorized write when role missing and Issue body deterministically defines projection
objects.READBACK_METHOD: list Issue comments via GitHub (bounded pagination) -> role resolution (exact label extraction) -> read exact comment by ID for raw revision/digest inspection; binding counts drive missing/duplicate/unique classification
objects.RAW_PRECONDITION_MODEL: per-comment raw revision token (e.g., comment updated_at or opaque revision) + raw body digest; precondition is observed raw revision/digest at read time; stale fails closed before mutate

objects.WRITE_METHOD: same as milestone_progress_index: update-in-place for canonical role; duplicate not allowed

objects.AUTHORITY_ROLE: operational projection: runtime activation evidence index; only where real runtime/deploy activity explicitly requires it (M4 does not activate runtime per D10)
objects.WRITE_METHOD: absent unless explicitly authorized runtime/deployment lifecycle requires it; otherwise M4-6 must not create/update; if required, same update-in-place + duplicate fail closed
objects.READBACK_METHOD: same role resolution plumbing; zero absent is not missing failure for this optional role outside activation context

objects.AUTHORITY_ROLE: append-only historical evidence; not semantic authority; grows monotonically
objects.WRITE_METHOD: append-only typed operation: appendEventLog(typed_target, correlation, candidate evidence, journal state) -> new comment; never edit/rewrite historical event semantics; never mutate or delete prior Event Log entries
objects.READBACK_METHOD: list comments + filter Event Log marker -> read newest for monotonic verification; no authoritative rewrite check beyond append confirmation via readback
objects.RAW_PRECONDITION_MODEL: append-only has no CAS on existing rows; precondition is at-most-one append of evidence per journal attempt; idempotency via correlation/attempt prevents duplicate evidence from replay

objects.AUTHORITY_ROLE: reserved for future projections derived deterministically from body; any new projection must be shown derivable from body; never competes as authority
objects.WRITE_METHOD: bounded typed projection write if future operation requires it; must obey same role-cardinality and update-in-place rules

critical_governance_rule_verified: Issue body / Portable Plan is authority. Control comments are operational projections/indexes, not independent semantic authority. Issue body wins; CONTROL_COMMENTS_PLAN_AUTHORITY=no; EVENT_LOG_PLAN_AUTHORITY=no; per M4-0 D9 and Issue #9 Governance / Authority Model.
read_before_write_summary: Every GitHub authority mutation requires read exact current raw object -> derive current raw revision/digest -> compare with M4-5 external authority precondition -> only then external apply eligibility; no blind overwrite.
verify_after_write_summary: gh/API call success is not verification; must re-read exact authoritative GitHub object -> compare raw result to candidate/original -> return typed observation for journal/recovery handling.
